notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/labs/knerlab__sim_control_software --backend fake (exit 0; evidence contract_checked, not an MHS-Device level; check-report.json has no findings and is regenerated by every gate run). The repository is a microscope-control application with three confirmed device classes; this package implements the first one, motorized_pol_v2:A8MRU (the motorized polarizer on an USMC controller). DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card is family-config/SerialDriver, but A8MRU opens no serial port and sends no text command: it loads USMCDLL.dll with ctypes and calls USMC_Init, USMC_Start and USMC_Stop (motorized_pol_v2.py:20, 68, 134), so this is a direct Driver over the upstream class with a native.py factory. NOT COVERED: the other entry symbols pyAndor_P35_a:ccd (Andor camera; its essential output is an image array, and it loads atmcd64d.dll from an absolute Windows path) and Lib64.asdk37:DM (Alpao deformable mirror via the compiled _asdk37 extension, which is not in the clone); inside A8MRU, MoveRel, MoveAbsWait (it has no timeout and can loop forever), the speed write (setSpeed has no getter and the clone states no range), the mode/params/start-parameter getters and setters, MotorOn/MotorOff, init and the static Start are not exposed. Only the position read, the absolute joint move, the stop and the e-stop are. The travel range is not stated anywhere in the clone and the initial mode disables both trailer limit switches (motorized_pol_v2.py:148-149), so joint_positions is Limit.operator_required and every move is refused MHS.SAFETY.LIMITS_UNSET until the operator supplies an envelope; site-limits.example.json is an example, not a statement about a unit. The fake is a package fake because the repository has no simulator, mock or recorded transcript for A8MRU; it is an in-memory object with placeholder values and no motion over time. The hardware backend (native.py) and the upstream package were never executed and no hardware run is claimed; the hardware path additionally needs Windows, USMCDLL.dll on the DLL search path and the external pol_rotator_p35 package (motorized_pol_v2.py:14-20), which are named in native.py and facts.md. The driver is R1 and model-authored with reviewed_by null, so the loader does not refuse its hardware backend on review grounds (that refusal is for R2 and R3 only); the backend remains an operator decision.
